_comment: MAINTAINER DATA. Which lattice types the maintainer has physically printed. Agents read this file and never edit it. To clear a type's 'Not print-tested' tag, print its sample block (topopt-cli lattice-sample) and set print_tested true with the date and a short note. Ids are core's topology ids.

octet.note: Graded 8 mm octet block; reprinted with supports on the plate only. 45 deg struts and 90 deg bridges self-supporting.

bccz.note: BCCZ block. Clean struts; bed adhesion harder (sharp cell corners on the plate). Not offered in round 1.
